Harmontide · a field guide to an inhabited world · volume XXI · the rodent family

Rodents

Two rodent monster girls: the capybara, calmest animal alive, and Ratatoskr, the squirrel who runs up and down the world tree carrying messages. Small, busy, and good company.

Favourite food: Seeds, nuts and greens; the capybara loves melon

The central similarity

Gnawers and gatherers.

Rodents gather: the capybara gathers friends around her, Ratatoskr gathers seeds and saplings (and forgets half of them).

  • CalmNo predator hunts near a capybara.
  • CachesRatatoskr's forgotten caches grow into trees.
  • MessagesRatatoskr carries items between friends.
  • CompanyIdle girls like to sit beside a capybara.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a rodent builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Food (+1), melon for the capybara (+2), seeds and berries for Ratatoskr (+2)
  • Petting

What costs trust

  • Hitting her

Devoted (60+)

She shares her calm: her devoted friends heal beside her (Regeneration).

Mating & young

FormLive young. YoungPups, grown in 5 days. WhereBeside her. Young use the adult model at 45%.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may share your bed.
2. PupsA day later she bears a litter.
3. YoungHer young stay by their mother.
4. GrownGrown in five days, devoted to their father.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

CalmWolves, foxes, cats and ocelots hunt nothing within 8 blocks of a capybara; idle girls nearby sit beside her.
Scatter-hoardingRatatoskr picks up seeds and saplings and plants the ones she forgets.
MessengerHand Ratatoskr an item: she carries it to the nearest other player she is fond of (now and then swapped as a prank).

Species profiles

Rivers & swampsCalm · beloved

Capybara (about 1.6 blocks)

TemperamentUnflappable

Ecology & behaviourHydrochoerus hydrochaeris (Rodentia: Caviidae), the largest rodent alive, famous for letting every other animal sit on or beside her.

Signature: CalmNo wolf, fox, cat or ocelot hunts within 8 blocks of her. Idle girls nearby sit down beside her. She soaks in water with a yuzu on her head.

Player interactionMelon, sugar cane and apples. Just sit with her.

Colour variants

Brown (default) · BrownSandy · SandyDark · Dark brownGinger · GingerGrey · Grey

Spawns inswamp, mangrove_swamp, river

DangerNone.

ForestsQuick · mischievous

Ratatoskr (about 1.4 blocks)

TemperamentQuick, chatty, a prankster

Ecology & behaviourThe squirrel who runs up and down Yggdrasil carrying insults between the eagle and the serpent. Her red squirrel is Sciurus vulgaris (Rodentia: Sciuridae).

Signature: MessengerShe carries an item you give her to the nearest other player she is fond of (now and then she swaps it for something else). She hoards seeds and saplings, and the ones she forgets grow into trees.

Player interactionSeeds and berries. Hand her something to deliver.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Sobolnik: befriended, her friend near her sees in the dark out of the sky's sight. House mouse: befriended, she shares a crumb with her hungry friend
  • Pineskrell: her crystal pinecones glow; befriended, the ores near her friend sparkle
  • Capybara: no wolf, fox, cat or ocelot hunts within 8 blocks; idle girls sit beside her; soaks in water
  • Ratatoskr: carries an item to the nearest other player she is fond of (one in eight swapped as a prank); hoards seeds and saplings and plants the ones she forgets
  • Live young
  • Mole: Haste underground. Meerkat: calls friends to a fight. Red Panda: keeps her friend from freezing
  • Beaver: chews logs into planks
  • Raccoon: finds odds and ends
  • Lemur: a morning buff. Mongoose: immune to poison, clears it from her friend
  • Tanuki: leaves into an emerald once a day. Skunk: sprays attackers
  • Sasquatch: befriended, her friend turns invisible while sneaking in a forest near her. Sun Wukong: befriended, her friend near her takes no fall damage
  • Gibbon: befriended, her friend near her climbs ladders, vines and scaffolding twice as fast
  • Rockhyrax: befriended, she whistles when a creeper comes near her friend, and it glows
  • Silkcoon: by water she washes the dye out of wool, carpets, beds, terracotta, stained glass and leather armour
  • Squirricerat: charges monsters near her friend; buries saplings that grow into trees. Kamaitachi: fast; her gusts cut tall grass, natural leaves and cobwebs round her friend
  • Marmotaur: whistles when monsters come within 16 blocks of her friend, and they glow; headbutts hard. Bambadger: befriended, her flute makes bamboo and sugar cane grow
  • Coatimano: finds suspicious sand and gravel within 12 blocks, brushes it out and carries the find to her friend
  • Needlehog: a hit or a sprinting stranger rolls her into a ball of quills (no damage gets through, attackers are pricked); hunts silverfish; keeps paper and books she finds, and gives them as presents

Not yet

  • A hamster, a beaver
